page.overview:
What is Tetsunokoube?

Iron Jugulis is a large cybernetic draconic Pokémon that resembles Hydreigon. It has a round plump body, and possesses three heads, with two of the heads acting as its hands, hovering separate from its body. It has short stub-like mechanical back legs, and a short, thin tail. It has various luminous, vaguely crystalline-looking magenta frills covering its three heads, and magenta stripes containing the same glowing plasma-like energy on its belly and tail. It has six thin black mechanical wings that it flaps, but seems to levitate with its cybernetic energy for the most part. Its heads, legs, part of its tail, and sides, are blue, with most of its body being metallic-black in color.

According to the paranormal magazine "Occulture", it was reported to have razed a building with a high-energy blast before flying off as if finding a new objective. As it combines Hydreigon's ferocity with the ruthlessness of a machine, it is believed to be some sort of cybernetic Hydreigon. Though ferocious in nature, once captured and tamed (as seen in its behavior in Scarlet and Violet), it becomes very loyal, and expresses natural-looking emotions (with all three of its heads) such as happiness, when interacted with. Unlike its present-day counterpart Hydreigon, it often displays happiness (expressed in all of its heads), rather than an expression of ferocity, toward its trainer. This behavior is unnatural for a purely mechanical creature; it acts as a cybernetic organism (similar to Miraidon).

Being a futuristic, cybernetic Hydreigon, Iron Jugulis possesses similar abilities to its present-day counterpart. Its thin metallic wings allow it to levitate. It has the abilities to use powerful, destructive plasmic energy, though it is intelligent and considers new objectives as it develops.

Sc; Union Circle; - V; Area Zero caverns; Rare
